.r-zeile b{font-family:var(--licht);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(32px,3.4vw,54px);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.r-zeile span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.7}
.rnr{position:fixed;z-index:70;left:16px;bottom:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:6px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.28);font:500 13px/1 var(--sans);color:#111}
.rnr b{font-weight:500;padding:0 10px}
.rnr a{width:30px;height:30px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:#EFECE6;color:#111;text-decoration:none;font-size:18px}

/* ===== ZIMMER 1 · Der Zollstock (Bewegung: federt satt an den Platz) ===== */
.zs-kopf{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5vw;align-items:end;margin-bottom:clamp(40px,4.5vw,70px)}
.zs-kopf .rl{justify-self:end;margin:0}
.zs-buehne{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.75fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(30px,4vw,64px);align-items:stretch}
.zs-bild{height:min(68vh,640px);border-radius:var(--rund);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 50px 90px -46px rgba(24,33,63,.55);transform:translateY(90px);transition:transform 1.5s var(--feder-leise)}
.zs.da .zs-bild{transform:none}
.zs-leiste{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:22px;transform:translateY(90px);transition:transform 1.5s var(--feder-leise) .12s}
.zs.da .zs-leiste{transform:none}
.zs-skala{position:relative;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(#C9A54E,#C9A54E);border-radius:2px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}
.zs-skala span{position:relative;left:14px;white-space:nowrap;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#8A6A2A;transform:translateY(-50%)}
.zs-skala span:last-child{transform:translateY(50%)}
.zs-skala{background:none;box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 #C9A54E}
.zs-reihen{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;padding-left:42px}
.zs-r{all:unset;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:16px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(24,33,63,.1);position:relative;transition:color .4s}
.zs-r::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-49px;top:50%;width:14px;height:2px;background:#C9A54E;transition:transform .6s var(--feder);transform-origin:left;transform:scaleX(.5)}
.zs-n{font-family:var(--licht);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(17px,1.45vw,23px);color:#5D667E;transition:color .4s,transform .6s var(--feder);display:inline-block}
.zs-m{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8A6A2A}
.zs-r.an .zs-n{color:var(--ink);transform:translateX(6px)}
.zs-r.an::before{transform:scaleX(2.2)}
.zs-r:hover .zs-n{color:var(--ink)}
.zs-zeile{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 28px;margin:28px 0 0;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:15px;color:var(--ink2)}
.zs-zeile b{font-family:var(--licht);font-weight:400;font-size:20px;color:var(--ink)}
/* ===== ZIMMER 2 · Drei grosse Zahlen (Bewegung: Zahl zählt hoch, Foto zoomt im Rahmen) ===== */
.gz-kopf{text-align:center;display:grid;justify-items:center;margin-bottom:clamp(50px,6vw,90px)}
.gz-z{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.35fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(30px,5vw,90px);align-items:center;max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto clamp(60px,7vw,110px)}
.gz-z--r .gz-bild{order:2}
.gz-bild{height:min(66vh,620px);border-radius:var(--rund);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 50px 90px -46px rgba(24,33,63,.5);transform:translateY(70px);transition:transform 1.5s var(--e1)}
.gz-bild img{transform:scale(1.14);transition:transform 2.6s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.gz.da .gz-bild{transform:none}.gz.da .gz-bild img{transform:none}
.gz-text .gz-zahl{margin:0;font-family:var(--licht);font-weight:200;font-size:clamp(120px,15vw,250px);line-height:.86;letter-spacing:-.05em;color:#B08B3A}
.gz-text .gz-zahl small{font-size:.22em;letter-spacing:0;margin-left:.15em;color:#8A6A2A}
.gz-text h3{margin:22px 0 0;font-family:var(--licht);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(26px,2.4vw,38px);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.gz-text p{margin:10px 0 0;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink2);max-width:40ch}
.gz-text .gz-preis{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8A6A2A}
/* ===== ZIMMER 3 · Zwei Etagen (Bewegung: oben kommt von oben in den Platz, unten von unten, das Bild zoomt) ===== */
.ze-kopf{text-align:center;display:grid;justify-items:center;margin-bottom:clamp(50px,6vw,90px)}
.ze-schnitt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr minmax(0,1.5fr) 1fr;gap:clamp(24px,3.4vw,56px);align-items:stretch;max-width:1380px;margin:0 auto}
.ze-bild{height:min(80vh,760px);border-radius:var(--rund);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 60px 100px -50px rgba(0,0,0,.85)}
.ze-bild img{transform:scale(1.12);transition:transform 2.8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.ze.da .ze-bild img{transform:none}
.ze-seite{display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-top:1px solid rgba(217,183,88,.4);padding-top:18px}
.ze-unten{justify-content:flex-end;border-top:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(217,183,88,.4);padding:0 0 18px;text-align:right}
.ze-oben{transform:translateY(-60px);transition:transform 1.5s var(--e1) .2s}
.ze-unten{transform:translateY(60px);transition:transform 1.5s var(--e1) .2s}
.ze.da .ze-oben,.ze.da .ze-unten{transform:none}
.ze-gross{margin:6px 0;font-family:var(--licht);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(28px,2.8vw,46px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.ze-seite p:last-child{margin:0;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:15px;opacity:.75}
.ze-zeile{margin:30px 0 0;text-align:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ms-h)}
.ze-paar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:10px;max-width:1380px;margin:clamp(60px,7vw,100px) auto 0}
.ze-paar figure{position:relative;height:min(52vh,480px);border-radius:var(--rund-m);overflow:hidden;transform:translateY(70px);transition:transform 1.5s var(--e1)}
.ze-paar figure:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.1s}
.ze.da .ze-paar figure{transform:none}
.ze-paar figcaption{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:60px 24px 20px;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:14px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(15,10,6,.62))}
.ze-paar figcaption b{display:block;font-family:var(--licht);font-weight:400;font-size:22px;margin-bottom:4px}

/* ===== SPA 1 · Die Wärmeleiter (Bewegung: Linie füllt sich von unten, Grade zählen, alles steigt langsam wie Wärme) ===== */
.wl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.2fr);gap:clamp(40px,6vw,110px);align-items:center}
.wl-text .rk{margin-top:34px}
.wl-flaeche{margin:40px 0 0;font-family:var(--licht);font-weight:200;font-size:clamp(80px,8vw,140px);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--ms-h)}
.wl-flaeche small{font-size:.3em;letter-spacing:0}
.wl-leiter{position:relative;display:grid;gap:12px;padding-left:120px}
.wl-linie{position:absolute;left:96px;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:rgba(217,183,88,.18)}
.wl-linie i{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--ms);transform-origin:bottom;transform:scaleY(.15);transition:transform 2.6s cubic-bezier(.3,.6,.2,1) .3s}
.wl.da .wl-linie i{transform:none}
.wl-st{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;transform:translateY(90px);transition:transform 2.2s cubic-bezier(.2,.65,.2,1)}
.wl-st:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.15s}.wl-st:nth-child(4){transition-delay:.3s}
.wl.da .wl-st{transform:none}
.wl-st figure{height:min(26vh,240px);border-radius:var(--rund-m);overflow:hidden}
.wl-st--t{padding:18px 0}
.wl-grad{position:absolute;left:-120px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:90px;margin:0;text-align:right;font-family:var(--licht);font-weight:300;font-size:30px;line-height:1.1;color:var(--ms-h)}
.wl-grad small{font-size:.55em}
.wl-st:first-of-type .wl-grad{font-size:12.5px;font-family:var(--mono);letter-spacing:.06em;line-height:1.7;color:#C9D0E2}
.wl-name{margin:10px 0 0;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:14.5px;opacity:.8}
.wl-st--t .wl-name{margin:0;font-family:var(--licht);font-size:clamp(22px,2vw,30px);opacity:1}
/* ===== SPA 2 · Die Anwendungen (Bewegung: Zeilen steigen in einem Zug aus dem Schlitz) ===== */
.anw{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.85fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(40px,6vw,110px);align-items:center}
.anw .an-hoch{height:min(88vh,860px);border-radius:var(--rund);overflow:hidden;transform:translateY(80px);transition:transform 1.6s var(--e1)}
.anw.da .an-hoch{transform:none}
.an-liste{margin:34px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.an-liste li{overflow:hidden;border-top:1px solid rgba(217,183,88,.25)}
.an-liste li:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(217,183,88,.25)}
.an-liste a{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:14px 0;color:#F4F2EC;text-decoration:none;font-family:var(--licht);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(24px,2.3vw,36px);letter-spacing:-.01em;transform:translateY(105%);transition:transform 1.2s var(--e1),color .4s}
.an-liste li:nth-child(2) a{transition-delay:.06s,0s}.an-liste li:nth-child(3) a{transition-delay:.12s,0s}.an-liste li:nth-child(4) a{transition-delay:.18s,0s}.an-liste li:nth-child(5) a{transition-delay:.24s,0s}
.anw.da .an-liste a{transform:none}
.an-liste em{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(217,183,88,.5)}
.an-liste svg{width:13px;height:13px;stroke:var(--ms-h);fill:none;stroke-width:1.5}
.an-liste a:hover{color:var(--ms-h)}
.an-paar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:34px}
.an-paar figure{height:min(22vh,200px);border-radius:var(--rund-m);overflow:hidden}
/* ===== SPA 3 · Der Ruheraum (Bewegung: das Bild atmet langsam aus, Zahlen zählen) ===== */
.rr-bild{position:relative;height:min(86vh,820px);border-radius:var(--rund);overflow:hidden}
.rr-bild img{transform:scale(1.14);transition:transform 3.4s cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.2,1)}
.rr.da .rr-bild img{transform:none}
.rr-bild::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:85%;height:85%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 12% 92%,rgba(8,12,32,.86),rgba(8,12,32,.6) 38%,transparent 72%);pointer-events:none}
.rr-bild figcaption{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:clamp(30px,4vw,70px);bottom:clamp(30px,4vw,64px);max-width:640px;color:#fff}
.rr-zahlen{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:clamp(50px,5vw,80px);text-align:center}
.rr-zahlen p{margin:0;font-family:var(--licht);font-weight:200;font-size:clamp(64px,6.4vw,110px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--ms-h)}
.rr-zahlen small{font-size:.32em}
.rr-zahlen span{display:block;margin-top:12px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#C9D0E2}
.rr-s{margin:34px auto 0;text-align:center}

/* ===== KÜCHE 1 · Das Menü eines Abends (Bewegung: Gänge legen sich nacheinander auf, Bild zoomt) ===== */
.me{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.05fr);gap:clamp(40px,6vw,100px);align-items:center}
.me-bild{height:min(84vh,800px);border-radius:var(--rund);overflow:hidden}
.me-bild img{transform:scale(1.15);transition:transform 2.8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.me.da .me-bild img{transform:none}
.me-menue{margin:34px 0 22px}
.me-g{padding:14px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(217,183,88,.24);transform:translateY(40px);transition:transform 1.3s var(--e1)}
.me-g:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.07s}.me-g:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.14s}.me-g:nth-child(4){transition-delay:.21s}.me-g:nth-child(5){transition-delay:.28s}
.me.da .me-g{transform:none}
.me-g p:last-child{margin:0;font-family:var(--licht);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(16px,1.3vw,19px);line-height:1.45}
.me-g i{display:inline-block;margin:0 10px;font-style:normal;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ms)}
.me .rk{margin-top:26px}
/* ===== KÜCHE 2 · Der Speisesaal von Heinz Julen (Bewegung: Bild zoomt aus, Zeilen steigen in einem Zug) ===== */
.sa-kopf{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5vw;align-items:end;margin-bottom:clamp(40px,4.5vw,70px)}
.sa-kopf .rl{justify-self:end;margin:0}
.sa-bild{position:relative;height:min(80vh,780px);border-radius:var(--rund);overflow:hidden}
.sa-bild img{transform:scale(1.16);transition:transform 3s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.sa.da .sa-bild img{transform:none}
.sa-bild::after{content:'';position:absolute;right:0;bottom:0;width:60%;height:60%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 95%,rgba(20,12,6,.75),rgba(20,12,6,.35) 45%,transparent 72%)}
.sa-bild figcaption{position:absolute;z-index:2;right:clamp(28px,4vw,64px);bottom:clamp(28px,4vw,56px);max-width:46ch;text-align:right;font-family:var(--licht);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(17px,1.4vw,21px);line-height:1.5;color:#fff}
.sa-tag{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:clamp(20px,3vw,48px);margin-top:clamp(50px,5vw,80px)}
.sa-tag>div{border-top:1px solid rgba(217,183,88,.35);padding-top:18px;transform:translateY(50px);transition:transform 1.4s var(--e1)}
.sa-tag>div:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.06s}.sa-tag>div:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.12s}.sa-tag>div:nth-child(4){transition-delay:.18s}
.sa.da .sa-tag>div{transform:none}
.sa-tag h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-family:var(--licht);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(24px,2.1vw,32px)}
.sa-tag p:last-child{margin:0;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;opacity:.8}
/* ===== KÜCHE 3 · Fünf Teller (Bewegung: die Teller werden in einem Zug aufgetragen) ===== */
.ft-kopf{text-align:center;display:grid;justify-items:center}
.ft-kopf .rs{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.ft-teller{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.25fr 1fr;align-items:center;gap:0;max-width:1400px;margin:clamp(30px,4vw,60px) auto 0}
.ft-t{aspect-ratio:3/2;transform:translateY(110px);transition:transform 1.6s var(--e1)}
.ft-t1{transition-delay:.08s}.ft-t2{transition-delay:.16s}
.ft-teller{max-width:1500px;margin-top:0}.ft-t{aspect-ratio:auto}.ft-t img{height:auto}
.ft.da .ft-t{transform:none}

/* ===== KINDER 1 · Die Burg (Bewegung: die Burg wächst mit Feder auf ihre Grösse) ===== */
.kb{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.3fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(40px,6vw,100px);align-items:center}
.kb-bild{position:relative;height:min(78vh,740px);border-radius:var(--rund);overflow:hidden;transform:scale(.9) translateY(40px);transition:transform 1.5s var(--feder-leise);box-shadow:0 50px 90px -46px rgba(24,33,63,.45)}
.kb.da .kb-bild{transform:none}
.kb-bild figcaption{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:70px 26px 22px;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:14.5px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(24,33,63,.6))}
.kb .rk{margin-top:30px}
/* ===== KINDER 2 · Kinder und Teenager (Bewegung: Schalter, Foto und Liste wechseln) ===== */
.kt-kopf{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:30px;margin-bottom:clamp(40px,4.5vw,70px)}
.kt-wahl{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:6px;border-radius:999px;background:#E2DACD;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 6px rgba(24,33,63,.14)}
.kt-wahl button{all:unset;cursor:pointer;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:999px;font-family:var(--licht);font-size:18px;color:#5D667E;transition:background .4s,color .4s,box-shadow .4s}
.kt-wahl .an{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 6px 16px -6px rgba(24,33,63,.4)}
.kt-buehne{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(30px,5vw,80px);align-items:center}
.kt-bild{height:min(68vh,620px);border-radius:var(--rund);overflow:hidden;transform:scale(.92);transition:transform 1.5s var(--feder-leise)}
.kt.da .kt-bild{transform:none}
.kt-listen{display:grid}
.kt-l{grid-area:1/1;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .5s}
.kt-l.an{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.kt-listen>.rs,.kt-listen>.rk{grid-row:2}
.kt-listen>.rk{grid-row:3;margin-top:26px;justify-self:start}
/* ===== KINDER 3 · Der Spielraum (Bewegung: die Breitbilder gleiten gegenläufig an ihren Platz, von unten und von oben) ===== */
.ks{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.6fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(40px,5vw,90px);align-items:center}
.ks-band{display:grid;gap:10px}
.ks-band figure{aspect-ratio:1417/559;border-radius:var(--rund-m);overflow:hidden;transform:translateY(80px);transition:transform 1.5s var(--feder-leise)}
.ks-band figure:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.1s}
.ks.da .ks-band figure{transform:none}
.ks .rk{margin-top:28px}

/* ===== SAASTAL 1 · Die Loipe (Bewegung: die Höhenlinie zeichnet sich von links, die Orte setzen sich) ===== */
.lo-kopf{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5vw;align-items:end}
.lo-kopf .rl{justify-self:end;margin:0}
.lo-profil{position:relative;margin:clamp(40px,5vw,70px) 0 0}
.lo-profil svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;overflow:visible}
.lo-fl{fill:rgba(24,33,63,.06)}
.lo-li{fill:none;stroke:#B08B3A;stroke-width:2.5;stroke-linejoin:round}
.lp circle{fill:var(--sn);stroke:#18213F;stroke-width:2}
.lp--h circle{fill:#B08B3A;stroke:#B08B3A}
.lp text{font-family:var(--licht);font-size:17px;fill:#18213F}
.lp .lp-m{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;fill:#8A6A2A}
.lp--h text{font-weight:500}
.lp{transform-box:fill-box;opacity:0;transition:opacity .6s ease calc(.3s + var(--i)*.22s)}
.lo.da .lp{opacity:1}
.lo-deck{position:absolute;inset:-60px -2% -10px 0;background:var(--sn);transform-origin:right;transition:transform 2.2s cubic-bezier(.45,.1,.2,1) .2s}
.lo.da .lo-deck{transform:translateX(102%)}
.lo-s{margin:30px auto 0;text-align:center;max-width:70ch}
.lo-paar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,70px)}
.lo-paar figure{height:min(50vh,460px);border-radius:var(--rund-m);overflow:hidden}
/* ===== SAASTAL 2 · Wo Pirmin anfing (Bewegung: der Satz steigt Zeile für Zeile, das Bild schwebt hoch) ===== */
.pa{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.5fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(40px,5vw,90px);align-items:center}
.pa-satz blockquote{margin:0;font-family:var(--licht);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(30px,3.3vw,54px);line-height:1.18;letter-spacing:-.015em;transform:translateY(60px);transition:transform 1.6s var(--e1)}
.pa.da .pa-satz blockquote{transform:none}
.pa-bild{height:min(74vh,700px);border-radius:var(--rund);overflow:hidden;transform:translateY(100px);transition:transform 1.8s var(--e1) .15s}
.pa.da .pa-bild{transform:none}
.pa-zahlen{grid-column:1/-1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:24px;margin-top:clamp(30px,4vw,60px);text-align:center}
.pa-zahlen p{margin:0;display:grid;gap:8px;border-top:1px solid rgba(24,33,63,.16);padding-top:20px}
.pa-zahlen b{font-family:var(--licht);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(34px,3.6vw,58px);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.pa-zahlen span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink2)}

.sw-kopf{text-align:center;display:grid;justify-items:center;margin-bottom:clamp(40px,5vw,70px)}

.sw-paar figure::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:70%;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(12,18,40,.55) 40%,rgba(12,18,40,.85));pointer-events:none}

.mw-kopf{margin-bottom:clamp(30px,4vw,60px)}

.mw-bild::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-20% auto -20% 0;width:40%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(255,250,235,.38),transparent);transform:translateX(-120%) skewX(-12deg);transition:transform 1.6s ease 1s}
.mw.da .mw-bild::after{transform:translateX(330%) skewX(-12deg)}
.mw-listen{display:grid}
.mw-l{grid-area:1/1;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .5s}

/* ===== ANGEBOTE 2 · Der Gutschein (Bewegung: der Gutschein schwebt hoch, ein Glanzstreif läuft darüber) ===== */
.gs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(40px,6vw,100px);align-items:center}
.gs-bild{height:min(80vh,760px);border-radius:var(--rund);overflow:hidden}

.gs-karte{position:relative;overflow:hidden;margin:34px 0 10px;padding:30px 34px;border-radius:var(--rund-m);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1E2A55,#0E1638);color:#F4F2EC;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.14),inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(217,183,88,.4),0 40px 70px -34px rgba(10,17,41,.8);transform:translateY(80px);transition:transform 1.6s var(--e1) .1s;max-width:460px}
.gs.da .gs-karte{transform:none}
.gs-karte::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-30% auto -30% 0;width:35%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(233,212,154,.28),transparent);transform:translateX(-140%) skewX(-12deg);transition:transform 1.5s ease 1.4s}
.gs.da .gs-karte::after{transform:translateX(420%) skewX(-12deg)}
.gs-z{position:absolute;right:26px;top:22px;width:74px;color:var(--ms);opacity:.9}
.gs-z svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.gs-name{margin:6px 0 0;font-family:var(--licht);font-weight:300;font-size:30px;line-height:1.15}
.gs-ort{margin:14px 0 0;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ms-h)}
.r-liste--l a{font-family:var(--licht);font-size:19px}
/* ===== ANGEBOTE 3 · Die Jasswochen (Bewegung: die Wochen werden wie Karten nacheinander ausgelegt, Kante an Kante) ===== */
.jw-kopf{text-align:center;display:grid;justify-items:center;margin-bottom:clamp(40px,5vw,70px)}

/* ===== SCHLUSS (Bewegung je Fassung: Bild atmet aus · Sterne setzen sich · Bild atmet aus) ===== */
